App turns on bracketed paste; a paste is one event (#559)

* App turns on bracketed paste, and a paste reaches a program as one event, never as the keys it holds (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)

* Paste: Escape ahead of a paste stays Escape, no control reaches a field, the field follows a paste, the end marker is sought once, WidgetApp hears pastes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)

* Paste: the program hears it first and may claim it, a flush ends an open paste as one, a tab is a space, only a final line break is dropped (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)

* Paste: an idle bound ends an unfinished paste as a paste, a split start marker is held, Dropdown filters by a paste, one-pass sanitizing (rich-control-codes-xh4n.rd8)
